correctness.rationale: For L iid outcomes 0,1,2 with probabilities 1−theta,theta/2,theta/2, exchangeability gives Cov(V,H)=2 P(X=0)[E(H|X=0)−EH]. Conditional bin-two probability theta/(2−theta); H=(X+Y+|X−Y|)/2 and binomial size bias give Cov=(1−theta/2)^L L theta[theta/(2−theta)−E h(1+Bin(L−1,theta))]. The central-binomial h is nonincreasing (indeed strict on alternate increments), and B coupling implies the expectation is strictly decreasing for L>=2 while theta/(2−theta) increases; endpoint signs yield exactly one theta_L∈(0,1). CLT for sparse ternary difference at theta=c L^{-1/3} with uniform integrability gives asymptotic c=(8/pi)^{1/3}, not finite-L equality. L=2 root 3−sqrt5 and L=1 exception follow directly. Independent exhaustive exact-rational enumeration of 16 (L,theta) cases for L=2..5 at theta=1/7,1/3,2/3 corroborated formula. No results for more bins or nonuniform allocation.
